title: MACHINES A THIRD LARGER
why: His order 10-20: enemies need to be like 33 percent larger. The eight machine kinds are drawn 1.33x around their feet (one number, FIG_MACH) and a round hits them at 1.33x the body radius. Walking, doors and the nav grid keep the old radius. Pillager bots, the peddler and the survivor keep their size.
now: Machines draw a third larger and are easier to hit.
